From your walk to their browser.

One space, four steps. You walk it with the phone; Veylet builds and checks the walkthrough automatically; nothing is shared until you approve it.

  1. Walk the space with the phone upright. At each spot, turn until the ring closes; the app flags anything it still needs before you finish.

  2. Finish and check the saved route, then send the capture to Veylet through the private transfer we arrange with you; in-app sending is not enabled yet.

  3. Veylet builds the walkthrough and an automatic quality check tests photo match, coverage and walkable paths. It is usually within 1–2 hours of the upload finishing. Not good enough? It retries once, then names the rooms to recapture, and nothing is counted.

  4. Review the exact version on your phone, then share a link or a website embed. Viewers need no app or account; revoking stops new access.

Before you write.

What does a walkthrough cost?

3 free months from the day you activate the plan, with 6 accepted walkthroughs included across them; the first charge is on the day they end, and cancelling before then charges nothing. Then the Veylet plan, monthly or annual. Monthly is A$99 a month by card or studio invoice, or A$119.99 a month in the App Store, with 2 accepted walkthroughs a month; unused ones roll over, up to 4 banked. Annual is A$990 a year by card or studio invoice (2 months free), or A$1,199.99 a year in the App Store, with 24 walkthroughs to use any time in the plan year. For busier months, add a pack of 3 walkthroughs for A$169 or 10 for A$499, each valid 12 months; for a fast one, a Super fast render is A$29, ready in about 30 minutes, any day, any time, or refunded, sold only while fast GPUs are starting quickly. Seats are unlimited, hosting, link and embed are included, and every released walkthrough stays live while you subscribe. If your first walkthrough isn’t listing-ready, we redo it free. App Store subscriptions renew unless cancelled through Apple; studio invoices follow your written agreement. The offer page itemises your first year. An enquiry is free and does not reserve a booking.

Can I see a real customer example?

We do not yet have a client-accepted tour to show. Our captures are still under quality review. The room images and animations here are labelled illustrations. Ask about the current pilot scope; we will explain what has been tested before agreeing any work.

Does applying create an account or take payment?

No. Apply and request do not create an account and take no payment. Anyone can join the waitlist; new accounts are admitted in weekly groups and sign in with the email they joined with. You can request a walkthrough without an account.

Can I get a walkthrough without the capture app?

Yes. Request a walkthrough. Managed clients do not need Veylet Capture installed.

How do I become a capture operator?

Apply. We assess device, software and a practice capture. After approval you pay to use the app and system. No jobs, leads or earnings promise.
